review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–100). It has no @[simp] declarations and no local simp-set design. It uses simp in one place, `simpa [← effectiveEpi_desc_iff_effectiveEpiFamily, (effectiveEpi_tfae (Sigma.desc π)).out 1 2]` in `effectiveEpiFamily_tfae`. This is an explicit, local, reversed rewrite, which is the right way to use a non-simp iff. The same pattern appears in the CompHaus and Stonean analogues. `effectiveEpi_desc_iff_effectiveEpiFamily` in Extensive.lean is also used with `simp only [←…]` and `rw`, so making it a global simp lemma would risk orientation and competing-rule problems. The other declarations are TFAE statements, instances and a def, and none is a good simp candidate. I did not run Lean, so I cannot rule out other issues. I found no justified simp-interface problem.
